title: Money Total Sheet
description: A full-stack financial ledger and transaction management application designed to track company pickups, deductions, and multi-currency balances with automated backups.
Highlights: Full-stack company ledger tracking scrap metal pickups, itemized weight and unit pricing, and payment deductions
Automated database backup system utilizing APScheduler with on-update triggers and scheduled pg_dump rotations
Customizable operational settings for multi-currency symbols, weight measurement units, and scrap yards
Automated Excel migration pipeline using Pandas to import and normalize historical transaction records
